title: Introduction to mathematical proof
audience: a college student in a mathematics degree program (or a related major such as physics, computer science or economics), or an adult studying the same material on their own
purpose: Write valid arguments, distinguish assumptions from conclusions, and find counterexamples.

blocks.deliverable: Prove elementary divisibility and function statements.
Write induction with explicit base and inductive steps.
Week 7 proof assessment; construct examples and counterexamples.
Prove a bijection and explain a countability argument.
Locate the first unjustified step in three flawed arguments.
Defend two proofs and complete a 120 minute proof examination.

project: Prepare a portfolio of eight corrected proofs using several proof methods.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
